panel.title: Tools
panel.description: Select an area, process it, then inspect and export the results.

process.title: Process
process.description: Derives two layers from the AOI and publishes a legend for each.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Add a standalone demo layer or a PMTiles vector layer, or clear the map and its legends. Both show up in the layer control, top right.

export.title: Export
export.description: Send the AOI or a processed output to Earth Engine, Drive or SEPAL.

tasks.adding_layers: Adding derived layers to the map...

toasts.process_done: Processing complete. Pick a layer in the map legend to inspect it.

errors.no_aoi: Select an AOI first before running processing.
errors.simulated: Simulated failure: external API returned malformed JSON at line 42.

export.aoi_description: The AOI feature collection currently selected in the sidebar.
export.pixel_area_description: Continuous output. Its map legend is the gradient built from vis_params.
export.elevation_description: Classified output. Its legend lists per-class areas in the detail column.
export.multi_band_description: Shows the ExportLauncher band picker: keep every band or narrow to a subset.
